displayName: LSASS Memory Dump via Comsvcs or Native Dump Utilities

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (FileName =~ "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("comsvcs", "minidump"))
    or (FileName in~ ("procdump.exe", "procdump64.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("-ma", "lsass"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: LSASS Memory Dump via Comsvcs or Native Dump Utilities
alertTemplate.description: Detects attempts to dump Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) process memory using rundll32 with comsvcs.dll MiniDump or Sysinternals procdump. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1657. Advisories: acsc-2026-10-09-chinese-state-linked-automated-tools.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Isolate the host immediately, inspect for dumped credential files, and rotate credentials for all accounts with active sessions on the endpoint (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1657; Advisories: acsc-2026-10-09-chinese-state-linked-automated-tools).
